name: v1_1_application_release_qa
objective: Close the remaining application-specific release QA gaps without changing scientific behavior. Add deterministic semantic tests for a valid two-phase submitted case, a valid single-phase submitted case, genuine structured failure presentation, actual CSV/JSON download payloads and MIME metadata, stale-result behavior after input changes, all five page destinations, disabled-action explanations, and absence of deprecated Streamlit APIs. Add a lightweight local Streamlit startup and HTTP health smoke helper or test using the existing environment only; it must use a bounded timeout, terminate its own child process, require no network beyond localhost, and expose a clear command for final QA. Make only narrowly necessary application fixes revealed by those tests. Never weaken a test or scientific expectation.
scientific_invariants: Every file under src/pvt_phase_simulator remains byte-unchanged.
Tests pin existing public scientific results and presentation semantics; they do not redefine expected science.
No scientific equation, algorithm, tolerance, status, result object, dataset, or baseline changes.
A valid two-phase result remains two-phase, a valid single-phase result remains informational, and genuine failures remain failures.
Exports use only current non-stale calculated results, preserve source floats, and never trigger or fabricate calculations.
Protected artifacts and all pre-existing scientific tests remain byte-unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Application semantic tests cover invalid input, valid single-phase, valid two-phase, failure, stale state, navigation, disabled actions, and downloads.
A bounded local command starts the real Streamlit entry point, receives a healthy localhost response, and always terminates the spawned server.
No deprecated use_container_width API appears in the UI package.
All tests are deterministic and do not require external services, credentials, or a browser dependency.
required_tests: import pvt_phase_simulator_ui; import pvt_phase_simulator_ui.app; import pvt_phase_simulator_ui.views
notes: Codex built until its usage quota expired mid-run (exit 1, no output contract). Claude reviewed, verified and finished it with no source changes required, and committed 514d963. All eight gates pass (1182 tests). NOT independently reviewed.
